meta.description: Schema export for the Company Registry module plus the Dividend sub-module (Phase 34D/E). This file documents table structures for future SQL migration.

relationship_with_db_schema.note: The existing db_schema.py (agentmesh/platform/db_schema.py) contains tables for identity, tasks, escrow, audit, and reputation (MVP Modules 1-5). The Company Registry (Module 6 for Phase 34) and Dividend (Phase 34D/E) are new and not yet included in db_schema.py. A future migration should add the following tables to db_schema.py.

migration_plan.foreign_keys: Application-level only (no DB-level FK constraints, consistent with existing db_schema.py pattern)
migration_plan.recommended_action: Append Company, CompanyMember, EquityShare, DividendFund, and DividendRecord CREATE TABLE statements to the SCHEMA_SQL string in db_schema.py
example_migration_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS companies (
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_companies_founder ON companies(founder_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_companies_status ON companies(status);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS company_members (
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_members_agent ON company_members(agent_id);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS equity_shares (
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_equity_company ON equity_shares(company_id);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dividend_funds (
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_df_company ON dividend_funds(company_id);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dividend_records (
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dr_agent ON dividend_records(agent_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dr_fund ON dividend_records(fund_id);

companies.description: Agent-owned companies / organisations on the platform. Each company has a single founder (the creating agent) and supports multiple members.

columns.name: founder_id
columns.description: Agent ID of the founding agent (references agents.id)

columns.name: status
columns.description: Life-cycle status: active, frozen, or dissolved

company_members.description: Many-to-many relationship linking agents to companies. Each membership carries a role. The founder role is assigned automatically on company creation and is unique per company (single founder).

columns.name: role
columns.description: Membership role: founder, admin, or member

company_members.note: WITHOUT ROWID suggested for SQLite since PRIMARY KEY (company_id, agent_id) is already the natural clustered index.

equity_shares.description: Records equity share grants to company members. Supports multiple share classes (founder, common, preferred) but enforces uniqueness per (company_id, agent_id, share_class) tuple.

columns.name: shares
columns.description: Number of equity shares granted (must be > 0)

columns.name: share_class
columns.description: Share class: founder, common, or preferred

dividend_funds.description: Records deposits into a company's dividend pool. Each row represents a batch of profit available for proportional distribution to shareholders.

columns.name: source
columns.description: Funding source label (escrow, task_reward, task_contribution, etc.)

columns.name: closed_at
columns.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the fund was closed/distributed

dividend_records.description: Per-shareholder allocation records created when a dividend fund is distributed. Each record reflects a proportional payout based on equity shares at snapshot time.

columns.name: shares_at_snapshot
columns.description: Number of shares held by this agent at snapshot time

columns.name: total_shares
columns.description: Total outstanding shares at snapshot time

columns.name: claimed_at
columns.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the dividend was claimed
